products.visualText: The GX-79 Voltes V Full Action (F.A.) is the first release in the Soul of Chogokin Full Action sub-line, which emphasizes dynamic articulation and anime-accurate proportions over transformation features. Standing at approximately 18 cm tall, this figure is built using a combination of die-cast metal, ABS, and PVC, giving it both a solid feel and high visual fidelity. The set includes a wide variety of accessories: four interchangeable hands, two super electromagnetic strings, two spinning tops, two chain knuckles, two Gatling missiles, a Grand Fire launcher, a Voltes Bazooka, the iconic Heavenly Sword, and a display base to showcase the figure in action poses. This version is tailored for collectors who prioritize poseability and screen-accurate sculpting over combining mechanics.
